## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.19.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.19.1.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.19.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.19.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.19 build (0.19.0, 0.19.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **Tidier nodes.** A node's statuses (watched, prebunked, framed) now show
  once, as the row of icons under it; the extra rings, corner brackets,
  blinking dot and status words on its label are gone. Hover a node for the
  details.
- A node's name never sits on its own status icons, and area names (such as
  a crisis test or a lost area) step clear of named nodes.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.19 builds.
